The '''KPR security droid''', also called the '''KPR servant droid''', was a simple [[Droid/Legends|droid]] built by [[Lerrimore Droids]].

==Design==
KPR security droids were manufactured by [[Lerrimore Droids]]. They were small [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with a square [[Tread/Legends|treaded]] base. The droid's body was topped by a dome that was either [[Color/Legends|colored]] white<ref name="CCG" /> or green.<ref name="CCG-SE">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=2X-7KPR (Tooex)}}</ref>

==Role==
KPR units were used as [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], as well as to perform simple maintenance and diagnostic functions<ref name="CCG" /> in security devices.<ref name="CCG-SE" /> KPRs were often used on remote installations, such as [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], where they were tasked with activating [[Alarm system/Legends|alarm]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], security lighting, and [[Power fence/Legends|power fences]].<ref name="CCG" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several KPR units were active on the on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and they were also used at [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outposts.<ref name="CCG-SE" /> [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] owned [[2X-3KPR/Legends|2X-3KPR]], a KPR droid that was responsible for activating the [[Alarm system/Legends|alarm]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], security lighting, and [[Power fence/Legends|power fences]] on [[Lars homestead/Legends|his]] [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|larsmoisturefarm|Lars moisture farm}}</ref> Two KPRs were aboard the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] which captured [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="ANH" /> One was [[2X-7KPR]], a droid that had been stolen from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]],<ref name="CCG-SE" /> and the other was [[6Y-2KPR]].<ref name="VG">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp08.html|text=Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 8: Droids for Sale}}</ref>
